title: 🙃 Aarav's loop skips the last row... the off-by-one hiding in tests #python #loops
title_alts: 🔢 Aarav's loop counts to nine... why indexes start at zero, not one #python #arrays
😵 Aarav emailed nine of ten people... the off-by-one that costs a customer #python #loops
description_hook: Ten names went in. Nine emails went out. The tenth was never touched, and the tests still passed.
setting: a quiet home desk at night with one laptop

characters.name: Aarav
characters.description: twenty-four, short black curly hair, grey hoodie, silver ring on his thumb

claims.basis: a loop over indexes one to nine touches nine slots, arithmetic from the stated example
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration
follows from ten items in a zero-based list

claims.claim: the last index is always the length minus one

scenes.narration: Aarav's loop runs nine times, not ten.
scenes.caption: आरव का लूप दस बार नहीं, नौ बार सलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen on a dark wooden desk showing a short list of ten names, the tenth name greyed out and untouched while the other nine are marked green, one small lamp lighting the keyboard.

scenes.narration: The list holds ten names. Nine of them get an email.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट में दस नाम हैं। ईमेल सिर्य़ नौ को जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A mail outbox on a monitor with nine sent message rows stacked neatly and one empty slot at the bottom, warm lamp light falling across the desk.

scenes.narration: The tenth customer never hears from the system at all.
scenes.caption: दसवाँ ग्राहक सिस्टम से कुछ बी नहीं सुनता।
scenes.image_brief: A single unopened envelope lying alone on a desk beside a closed laptop, a mug of cold tea next to it, faint evening light from a window.

scenes.narration: Two minutes from now you will catch this instantly.
scenes.caption: दो मिनट बाद आप इसे तुरंत पकड़ लेंगे।
scenes.image_brief: A paper notebook open on a desk showing a hand-drawn row of ten boxes numbered zero to nine, a pencil resting in the fold, bright desk lamp above.

scenes.narration: Indexes start at zero. Counting starts at one.
scenes.caption: इंडेक्स शून्य से शुरू होता है, गिनती नेक से।
scenes.image_brief: Ten wooden blocks in a straight line on a table, each painted with a number from zero to nine, soft daylight coming from the side.

scenes.narration: So the last index is always the length minus one.
scenes.caption: इसलिए आख़िरी इंडेक्स हमेशा लंबाई से एक कम होता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wooden ruler on a plain table with ten small stones laid along it, the tenth stone sitting at the nine mark, even flat light.

scenes.narration: Ten items means indexes zero through nine, never ten.
scenes.caption: दस आइटम का मतलब इंडेक्स शून्य से नौ तक, दस नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A screen showing a row of ten coloured cells with index labels zero to nine printed beneath them, and an empty dotted cell labelled ten sitting outside the row.

scenes.narration: A loop from one to nine quietly skips the first slot.
scenes.caption: एक से नौ तक का लूप पहला स्लॉट चुपचाप छोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Nine of ten locker doors on a corridor wall standing open while the very first locker, numbered zero, stays shut, overhead strip lighting.

scenes.narration: Why did the tests pass? They counted rows, not names.
scenes.caption: टेस्ट पास क्यों हुए? उन्होंने गिनती जाँची, नाम नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A test results panel on a monitor with a full column of green ticks and one small grey skipped line at the bottom of the panel.

scenes.narration: Some languages hand you each item directly.
scenes.caption: कुछ बोलियाँ हर आइटम सीधे आपको देती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A short conveyor belt on a workbench carrying ten identical parcels one after another into a waiting crate, no numbers anywhere, cool workshop light.

scenes.narration: Then there is no index, so there is no off-by-one.
scenes.caption: तब इंडेक्स नहीं होता, इसलिए यह गलती बी नहीं होती।
scenes.image_brief: The crate on the workbench now holding all ten parcels, the belt empty and still, a clipboard beside it with every line ticked.

scenes.narration: Off-by-one is not carelessness. It is arithmetic.
scenes.caption: ऑफ़-बाय-वन लापरवाही नहीं, यह गणित है।
scenes.image_brief: A chalk board with one line of chalk arithmetic reading length minus one, a duster resting on the ledge, plain room, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Open your newest loop and print both end items.
scenes.caption: अपना सबसे नया लूप खोलें और दोनों सिरों के आइटम प्रिंट करें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen showing two lines of printed output, the first list entry and the last list entry one under the other, tidy desk, morning light.

title: 😵 Nandini's function keeps yesterday's list... the default argument trap #python #functions
title_alts: 🧺 Nandini's empty list is not empty... how default arguments are really built #python #functions
🔁 Nandini's report grows every run... the mutable default nobody warns about #python #debugging
description_hook: Her function starts with an empty list every time. Except it does not, and the third run proves it.
setting: a small office desk with a second monitor
protagonist_type: backend developer on a small team

characters.name: Nandini
characters.description: thirty-one, long dark hair tied back, olive green shirt, thin wire-framed glasses

claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: by run three the report shows nine
claims.basis: three orders per run accumulated over three runs, arithmetic from the stated figures
three plus three from the figures already stated

claims.claim: built once, when the function is defined
claims.basis: standard evaluation order of default parameters in Python

scenes.narration: The empty list in your function is not empty.
scenes.caption: आपके फ़ंक्शन की खाली लिस्ट असल में खाली नहीं है।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing a short function definition whose empty square brackets glow faintly amber, dim office at dusk, keyboard lit only by the screen.

scenes.narration: Nandini's function gathers three new orders each run.
scenes.caption: नंदिनी का फ़ंक्शन हर रन में तीन नए ऑर्डर जोड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A screen with a small table of three order rows, an order number and a price in each row, a mug and a notepad beside the keyboard.

scenes.narration: By the third run the report shows nine.
scenes.caption: तीसरे रन तक रिपोर्ट में नौ दिखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: The same on-screen table now stretched to nine order rows with a scrollbar on the right, the top rows faded as if older.

scenes.narration: You will see why, and the one line that fixes it.
scenes.caption: आप कारण देखेंगे, और वह एक लाइन जो इसे ठीक करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A sticky note pressed to the edge of a monitor with one short line of code written on it in marker, office ceiling light overhead.

scenes.narration: A default value is built once, when the function is defined.
scenes.caption: डिफ़ॉल्ट वैल्यू एक बार बनती है, जब फ़ंक्शन बनाया जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single empty glass bowl on a bare wooden shelf with a small paper label reading default taped beneath it, soft side light.

scenes.narration: Every later call reaches into that same list.
scenes.caption: हर अगली कॉल उसी एक लिस्ट में हाथ डालती है।
scenes.image_brief: Three hands reaching toward the same glass bowl on the shelf, each dropping a small folded paper slip into it, the bowl filling up.

scenes.narration: The first call returns three orders. Fair enough.
scenes.caption: पहली कॉल तीन ऑर्डर देती है। ठीक है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed slip on a desk listing three order lines and a total, a small printer beside it, evening light through the blinds.

scenes.narration: The second call returns six. Nothing was added twice.
scenes.caption: दूसरी कॉल छह देती है। कुछ बी दो बार नहीं जोड़ा गया।
scenes.image_brief: Two printed slips lying side by side on a desk, the left one with three order lines and the right one with six, the extra three circled in pen.

scenes.narration: The list simply never went back to empty.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट कबी दोबारा खाली ही नहीं हुई।
scenes.image_brief: The glass bowl on the shelf packed with paper slips spilling onto the shelf, the default label still visible under the pile.

scenes.narration: Numbers, strings and tuples cannot be changed in place.
scenes.caption: नंबर, स्ट्रिंग और टपल जगह पर नहीं बदले जा सकते।
scenes.image_brief: Three sealed glass paperweights on a desk, a different number frozen inside each one, nothing able to get in or out, cool window light.

scenes.narration: Lists, dictionaries and sets are the ones that remember.
scenes.caption: लिस्ट, डिक्शनरी और सेट वही हैं जो याद रखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Three open containers on the same desk, a bowl, a filing box and a jar, each half full of folded paper slips, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Default to none. Build the list inside the function body.
scenes.caption: डिफ़ॉल्ट को none रखें। लिस्ट फ़ंक्शन के अंदर बनाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor showing the corrected function, the default now the word None, and a fresh empty list created on the first line of the body.

scenes.narration: Search your project for empty brackets inside a signature.
scenes.caption: अपने प्रोजेक्ट में सिग्नेचर के अंदर खाली ब्रैकेट खोजें।
scenes.image_brief: A code editor search panel open with a query typed into it and four matching result lines listed beneath it, quiet office, screen glow.
